name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Accessible color picker with a saturation and brightness field, hue, alpha, and a hex input.

meta.descriptionEs: Selector de color accesible con área de saturación y brillo, tono, alfa y un campo hexadecimal.

examples.title: Selector de color
examples.description: Selector de color accesible con área de saturación y brillo, tono, alfa y un campo hexadecimal.

api.name: value
api.description: h in degrees, s and v and a from 0 to 1.

api.name: onValueChange
api.description: Fires for the field, sliders, and hex commit.

api.name: labels
api.description: hue, alpha, hex, and saturation labels default to English.

docs: hsvaToCss, hsvaToHex, and hexToHsva are exported. Arrow keys move saturation and brightness. The component does not ship a palette. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
